source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Ribes aureum Pursh var. villosum DC.

morphology_documented.habit: Erect unarmed shrub to about 2 m
morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate simple 3–5-lobed leaves 3–8 cm broad, lobes often toothed
morphology_documented.flowers: Usually nodding racemes of 3–10 fragrant five-parted flowers; yellow calyx with tubular portion 10–15 mm, petals yellow to red, inferior ovary
morphology_documented.fruit: Ovoid to globose berry 7–10 mm, yellowish becoming black

source_scope_note: Historical species treatments and explicitly identified genus/key characteristics only; missing morphology not inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: 1999 flora's taxon is specifically var. villosum, and its characters must not automatically represent all accepted varieties of Ribes aureum
Flora's occurrence relies on cited vegetation-area report; not direct Hays county record
preservation: Additive record only, original species and photo/credits/gallery unchanged
